name: Ichikawamisato (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ichikawamisato town emblem in white: a stylised human figure with a raised arm and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ichikawamisato, a town in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Ichikawamisato town emblem — a stylised human figure with a raised arm and a disc
